additional_info.subject: RE: ID0471172-DC/Si-D/IT- [Multi] Meter values not transmitted CRM:03289000172
additional_info.body:
Buonasera Giuseppe,
I am writing you in regards of ticket
ID0471172
for meter values not transmitted to the Backend on chargers 170004362 and 170004376.
It is correct that the meter values are not transmitted, because the Backend did not ask for them in first place.
I checked via ssh the config files of both chargers, and the "MeterValueSampleInterval" is set to 0:
According to the OCPP 1.6 standard "A value of "0" (numeric zero), by convention, is to be interpreted to mean that no sampled data should be transmitted."
Therefore, the customer has to set this key from the Backend.
There are two ways to set the OCPP key:
The Backend has a section where you can modify the values of all keys.
You can set the MeterValueSampleInterval via "ChangeConfiguration.req". Here is an example of ChangeConfiguration.req:
The value has to be an integer and it is expressed in seconds.
Please convey this information to the customer, and let me know if you need further support on the topic.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer

13629 Berlin, Germany

additional_info.subject: Status Update
additional_info.body:
The chargers are not directly connected to an OCPP Backend but to a SCADA system.
Today during site intervention, I configured the MeterValueSampleInterval directly via SSH by editing the config JSON file.
Tested on charger
MP/T2170004376
and MeterValues are sent correctly.
Issue solved, ticket to be closed.
